issues.detail: Hebrew 'יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל' means 'right or left' (both directions). The Chinese renders 'שְׂמֹאל' as '左手' (left hand), which is a mistranslation of the directional term 'left' into a body part, changing the meaning from 'turn aside to the right or to the left' to 'turn aside to the right or to the left hand'.
